notes.title: Minor Fix #6 - Balance Patch & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Balance
We have made some balance adjustments.


 The time to lose pizza balance has increased from 1.5 seconds to 3 seconds.
 Character inertia (sliding) has been slightly reduced.
 The responsiveness of the balancing hand has been improved.
 Additional shelters have been placed to reduce player fatigue.

Bugs

 Fixed a bug where certain UI elements were not applied when controlled with the mouse.



Thank you for your continued interest and support for our game.
Although there are still many areas to improve, we will keep working hard to provide a more enjoyable experience.

Sincerely,
AnomalyGuys

notes.title: minor #4 Elevator Visibility Patch in the City Area
notes.notes: It has been confirmed that the shortcut section in the city area is unclear. As a result, the design of this section has been partially modified.

notes.title: release on January 22
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281623/6aaa6644718b2d472a915b68e1c5cae93a578ca4.png
Hello, this is AnomalyGuys!

First of all, we would like to express our heartfelt thanks to everyone who has shown interest and support for our game, "GuGu Pizza : Delivering Pizza to the Space Station? Boss, this is just not right!"

We are thrilled to bring you some exciting news!
Gugu Pizza will officially launch on January 22, 2025!
KST 01/22/2025 5:00 PM
PST 01/22/2025 12:00 AM

Thanks to your support and encouragement, we’ve come this far.
In the remaining time until release, we will do our best to refine the game and enhance its quality to bring you the best fun possible.

Get ready for the chaotic adventure of delivering pizza in space, filled with laughter and challenges along the way!

We’ll see you on Steam on January 22, 2025!
Thank you!

Sincerely,
AnomalyGuys
